HUD_TITLE.title: Formula Editor: Manual Override
HUD_TITLE.intent: Use formulas to directly control the 3D shape.
HUD_TITLE.proseBehavior: Provides a live view of GLSL expressions. Edits here override the interface presets. Any formulas you write manually will be erased if you update the interface controls.

ABOUT_LANDMARK.title: Documentation: About
ABOUT_LANDMARK.intent: Learn more about the Parametric Engine.
ABOUT_LANDMARK.proseBehavior: Click to open the README documentation in a new tab. Contains detailed instructions, mathematical references, and keyboard shortcuts.

STATUS_LANDMARK.title: Engine Status: Mathematical Integrity
STATUS_LANDMARK.intent: Monitor the health of the current 3D calculation.
STATUS_LANDMARK.proseBehavior: Interaction: [Green] Formula is valid and rendering. [Red] Formula contains a mathematical or syntax error. Hover for specific error details. The engine will pause updates until the error is resolved.

SHAPE_DRAWER.title: Shape: Base Topology
SHAPE_DRAWER.intent: Choose the starting form for your 3D model.
SHAPE_DRAWER.tableBehavior: Selects the starting vertex distribution (e.g., Sphere, Klein Bottle, Romanesco Broccoli Floret). Initial state is a circle morphed by temporal oscillation.

PROJECT_DRAWER.title: Project: Vector Mapping
PROJECT_DRAWER.intent: Select which internal values control the X, Y, and Z axes. Changing these rotates the shape. Deselecting an axis flattens the shape to 2D.
PROJECT_DRAWER.tableBehavior: Determines which internal calculation (x, y, or z) drives the physical X, Y, and Z coordinates.

BEND_DRAWER.title: Bend: Curvature & Arching
BEND_DRAWER.intent: Curve the shape along its main axes.
BEND_DRAWER.tableBehavior: Calculates an angular arc based on vertex position.
BEND_DRAWER.mathExpression: theta = (v - 0.5) * amt * scalar; x' = dist * cos(theta)

PINCH_DRAWER.title: Pinch: Vertex Concentration
PINCH_DRAWER.intent: Pull points together or spread them along an axis.
PINCH_DRAWER.tableBehavior: Concentrates points toward an axis origin or tapers them toward the poles.

TEXTURE_DRAWER.title: Texture: Surface Displacement
TEXTURE_DRAWER.intent: Add fine bumps and waves to the surface.
TEXTURE_DRAWER.tableBehavior: Displaces vertices along their normal using a composite sine/cosine wave function.

SPIRAL_DRAWER.title: Spiral: Coordinate Torsion
SPIRAL_DRAWER.intent: Twist the shape around its center.

MODULATE_DRAWER.title: Modulate: Surface Oscillation
MODULATE_DRAWER.intent: Overlay gentle ripples or waves on the shape.
MODULATE_DRAWER.tableBehavior: Overlays a secondary wave function to create ripples.
MODULATE_DRAWER.mathExpression: Delta = sin(u * freq) * cos(v * freq) * amt

FLATTEN_DRAWER.title: Flatten: Linear Compression
FLATTEN_DRAWER.intent: Compress the shape along one direction.
FLATTEN_DRAWER.tableBehavior: Compresses the mesh along the selected vector.

EXPORT3D_DRAWER.title: Export: Geometry Output
EXPORT3D_DRAWER.intent: Save your model for use in other software.
EXPORT3D_DRAWER.tableBehavior: STL produces 3D manifold files. SVG (v0.5.4) projects the 3D view into a 2D vector path for plotting.
